dict.Biletele la ordin și cecurile primite de: Promissory notes and cheques received from customers or given to suppliers: the amount, the due date and what has been collected or paid; you get the balance, the days until the due date and the status: collected or paid (green), in portfolio or to pay (blue), due within 7 days (yellow), overdue or refused for payment (red), with the balance for a chosen partner.
dict.Biletul la ordin se prezintă la plată în: A promissory note is presented for payment on the due date or within the next 2 working days; presented later, you lose part of your rights against the endorsers.
dict.Cecul se prezintă la bancă în cel mult 8: A cheque is presented to the bank within 8 days of its issue date: for cheques, enter the issue date plus 8 days under “Due date”.
dict.Încasarea trece și în Sheets → Evidență: The collection is also entered in Sheets → Issued invoices (or Supplier invoices, for payments), on the invoice the note was given for.
dict.Un bilet la ordin sau un cec refuzat din: A promissory note or cheque refused for lack of funds is an enforceable title: the money can be claimed through a bailiff, without a lawsuit; keep the original and the bank's refusal.
dict.Clientul:\nBiletul la ordin sau cecul (s:
Customer:
Promissory note or cheque (series and number):
Amount: lei
Due date:
For invoice:

When you receive it, check that it has:
☐ “promissory note” (or “cheque”) written in the text and the amount, in figures and in words, the same
☐ the due date, the place of payment and your company’s name as payee
☐ the date and place of issue, the customer’s signature and stamp (for a cheque, also their bank)
☐ no erasures or corrections; otherwise ask for another one
☐ entered in the table (Sheets → Promissory notes and cheques), with the invoice it was received for; the handover, in a report (Docs → Promissory note handover report)

On the due date:
☐ deposited at the bank on time (a promissory note on the due date or within the next 2 working days, a cheque within 8 days of issue)
☐ the collection entered in the table and on the invoice (Sheets → Issued invoices register): status “Collected”
☐ if refused: the original and the bank’s refusal kept, “Yes” under “Refused for payment” and the customer notified (Docs → Formal payment demand)

Notes:
•
dict.Când un client dă bilete la ordin sau ce: When a customer hands over promissory notes or cheques for their invoices: each note with its series, bank, issue date, due date, amount and the invoice it is given for, the total, the condition they were handed over in and the signatures of both parties
